desk:
**BLUF:** The OSINT community is focused on two major incidents in the last 48 hours: confirmation of three Russian Kh-101 missiles striking eastern Poland on 20 November, triggering a NATO emergency meeting, and Ukrainian USV strikes that sank the Russian Navy corvette *Merkury* in Benghazi, Libya. The Poland strike and its NATO implications stand out as the single most important development.

## MAIN THREADS
### Russian Kh-101 missiles strike Poland
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124583042815779208) reports Polish officials confirmed three Russian-made Kh-101 cruise missiles struck eastern Poland on Friday, with fragments identified as late-2026 production; NATO emergency meeting set for Monday.
- Multiple accounts note the strikes occurred during a Russian attack on Ukraine, with no immediate disagreement on the Russian origin.

### Ukrainian USVs sink Russian corvette in Libya
- [@Osinttechnical](https://x.com/Osinttechnical/status/2124575426601271626), [@Tendar](https://x.com/Tendar/status/2124573306938433671), [@Archer83Able](https://x.com/Archer83Able/status/2124573431379423625) and [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124577767601701160) all confirm the Steregushchiy-class corvette *Merkury* was sunk at berth in Benghazi by Ukrainian surface drones, citing satellite imagery showing it capsized with debris and fires.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124574697069175185) adds a Russian EMERCOM Il-76 departed Benghazi the same day.

### Related Russian shipping activity in Libya
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124579643730931945) links the struck vessels to earlier OSINT by @InsiderGeo and @SONARROW_OSINT showing Russian cargo ships loaded with military equipment in Kaliningrad.

### US DNI statement on nationwide outages
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124586303656444080) quotes Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton stating recent system outages are not coordinated or state-sponsored but may continue during upgrades.

## CONTESTED
Nothing contested.

## SINGLE-SOURCE CLAIMS
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124570800183513524) (unconfirmed): U.S. Army ARTEMIS II ISTAR aircraft was on task off Libya in the week before the strikes.
- [@sentdefender](https://x.com/sentdefender/status/2124579643730931945) (unconfirmed): Specific Russian cargo vessels (ASCALON, LADY D, ANASTASIIA) were involved in the Benghazi incident.

## WORTH WATCHING
Analysts are watching NATO’s Monday emergency meeting on the Poland strikes and any further Ukrainian operations against Russian assets in Libya or the Mediterranean. Russian response to the *Merkury* loss and potential additional missile incidents remain key.
